title.cn: 华强北：零件迷宫与日结诱惑

text.cn: 楼里像未来零件菜市场。有人拦你：『外模拍智能手表广告，两小时，日结。』旁边摊位在测耳机，低音炮把你的心跳一起测了。
text.en: Inside feels like a wet market for the future. Someone stops you: “Watch ad, two hours, paid today.” A stall tests earbuds — the bass tests your heartbeat too.

text.cn: 只逛不买：当电子人类学田野调查。

feedback.cn: 你看见了世上所有数据线的亲戚。钱包没死，方向感死了。
feedback.en: You meet every cable’s relatives. Wallet lives; orientation dies.

text.cn: 💰 接手表广告：对着镜头说 Wow。
text.en: 💰 Watch ad: say Wow to the lens.

lockedHint.cn: 约拍门槛：Sanity ≥ 70 且电量 ≥ 25。没电的模特只是一块会走路的背景板。
lockedHint.en: Gig gate: Sanity ≥ 70 and Battery ≥ 25. A dead-phone model is just a walking backdrop.

feedback.cn: Wow 说了二十次。日结到账。你对「智能」两个字开始过敏。
feedback.en: Twenty Wows. Paid. You develop a mild allergy to the word “smart”.

text.cn: 华强北日结束。你带走了报价单，没带走灵魂。
text.en: Huaqiangbei ends. You leave with price lists, not your soul.
